Overall, the high-grade enhancing necrotic phenotype in an older patient outweighs the cortical-location counterpoints, so the conclusion is IDH-wildtype.

The strongest imaging signal is an older patient with a solitary, markedly enhancing, thick-rim, necrotic, edematous mass, favoring glioblastoma. 1p/19q confidence is lower because MRI metadata lacks calcification assessment and molecularly specific features.
